usedFor: Evenium manages the guest list and Asana tracks follow-up, so “New Guests Added” runs “Create Task or Subtask”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Guests Added” in Evenium, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: Each new guest gets a task, so someone on the team owns the follow-up.

watchOut: “Guest Created or Updated” fires on edits too, so the same guest can create more than one task.
